text: Fish for facts, and take pains to be well informed of everything that passes; but fish judiciously, and not always, nor indeed often, in the shape of direct questions, which always put people upon their guard, and, often repeated, grow tiresome.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CLXXXVI, to his son, London, January 15, 1753
